test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who wrote Hind Swaraj in 1909?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hind Swaraj**, also known as 'Indian Home Rule', is a seminal work written by **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi** in **1909** while he was traveling from **London** to **South Africa**.
 
• The entire manuscript was written on the ship **SS Kildonan Castle** using the ship's stationery; Gandhi famously wrote with his left hand when his right hand became exhausted.
 
• The book was originally composed in **Gujarati** and was subsequently published in the columns of **Indian Opinion** in South Africa before being released as a book.
 
• It is written in a **dialogic form**, consisting of a conversation between an **Editor** (representing Gandhi's voice) and a **Reader** (representing the extremist nationalist viewpoint of the time).
 
• The text serves as a manifesto for **Swaraj** (Self-Rule), where Gandhi argues that India can only achieve true independence by rejecting **modern Western civilization** and adopting **Satyagraha** (non-violent resistance).
 
• In **1910**, the British authorities in India banned the Gujarati edition of the book, labeling it as **seditious literature**, which prompted Gandhi to publish the English translation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravindra Nath Tagore**

 
 
• He was a polymath who reshaped Bengali literature and music; he was the first non-European to win the **Nobel Prize in Literature** in **1913** for his collection **Gitanjali**.
 
• Tagore founded the **Visva-Bharati University** at **Shantiniketan** and is the author of the national anthems of both India and Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale**
 
 
• A prominent **Moderate** leader of the **Indian National Congress**, he was considered the **political mentor** or 'guru' of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• He founded the **Servants of India Society** in **1905** with the aim of training Indians to devote their lives to the cause of the nation.
 
 
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**
 
 
• Known as the 'Father of Indian Unrest', he was a key **Extremist** leader who famously declared, 'Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it'.
 
• During his six-year imprisonment in **Mandalay Jail**, he authored the famous commentary on the Bhagavad Gita titled **Gita Rahasya**.
